title: Animals
info: Animals can be grouped by how they look and live.
Mammals have fur or hair and feed milk to their young. Birds have feathers. Insects have six legs.
Reptiles have scales and lay eggs. Amphibians live part of their life in water and part on land.
Animals need food, water, shelter, and space to survive. Different animals live in different habitats.

questions.explain: Dolphins breathe air and feed milk to their calves.
Insects have six legs. Spiders have eight, so they are not insects.
